title: Oozy Crisp Hunan Spinach Bao
description: A resinous, midnight-craving Hunan-inspired bao filled with spicy spinach that becomes crispy when baked, yet stays low-calorie.
instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, salt, and sugar.
Dissolve yeast in warm water and let activate for 5 minutes.
Mix yeast mixture into dry ingredients and add olive oil to form a sticky dough.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 8 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour until doubled.
While dough rises, steam spinach until wilted, then squeeze out excess moisture.
In a pan, sauté minced garlic and grated ginger for 1 minute, then mix in steamed spinach, Hunan chili sauce, and sesame oil; season with salt to taste.
Punch down the risen dough and divide into 12 equal portions.
Flatten each portion into a circle, place 1 tablespoon of filling in the center, and pinch edges to seal into buns.
Place buns on a parchment-lined tray, cover loosely, and let rise again for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 200°C and bake buns for 12 minutes until golden and risen.
Garnish with sliced scallion before serving.
Serve hot for a midnight craving.
